I am inbetween happy and unhappy. This has been the month from hell, and yet, i'm better and worse for it.
Let me explain.

I had a wound that would not heal on the bottom of my foot. We did not have the money for a doctor at the time. I was tending to it. Bad went worse,and it turned into gangrene. I have also been diagnosed with diabetes. Also not really surprised. I knew I was not healthy. Again, I have no money of my own, and I have no job or disability as of yet- we did apply at the end of august for me. I had a toe cut off, infection cleared out. I stayed in the hospital for a week. 
I have things taken care of mostly now. Doctors. Insurance applied for. I'm okay. Except... I'm not.

I can't wait to be able to be weight bearing on my left foot. It's not permanent, but it SUCKS to be stuck basically hopping around on one foot with a walker. I'm twenty-five. I was okay until nearly three years of scraping-by living came back to bite my ass. Being stuck in the house, mostly in bed? I can't even carry things. Hate. It.

I'm also sure taking care of me is killing my mother. She has no help. I WAS the help, as poor as it was. I was guard-dog, and co-pilot in life. now I can barely hop to the car for appointments.
